title: phellandrium aquaticum var. microcarpum
intro: Phellandrium aquaticum var. microcarpum, commonly known as Water dropwort, is a plant species that belongs to the family Apiaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to aid in digestion and alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders, such as constipation and bloating. The therapeutic actions of Water dropwort include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Water dropwort include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
